image_description: A close-up, side-profile portrait of a rooster (cock). The image focuses heavily on the head and neck. Visible features include a bright red, serrated comb and wattles, a sharp yellow beak, and a distinct eye with an orange iris. The neck plumage consists of long, pointed hackle feathers with a striking black-and-white striped pattern. The background is dark and out of focus, showing hints of iridescent blue/green tail or body feathers, suggesting depth but lacking detail.
